name: ai-assets-library
description: Reusable Claude Code skills and mods from Logiciel Solutions.

plugins.name: ai-assets-skills
plugins.description: All skills in this library, installed as one plugin.

plugins.name: git-status-line
plugins.description: Git branch and changed-file count in the status line.

plugins.name: prompt-upgrade
plugins.description: /better: upgrade a rough prompt with quick questions and a side-by-side rewrite before it's sent.

plugins.name: model-switcher
plugins.description: Switch model and effort from a band above the prompt: one click or keypress, no slash commands.

plugins.name: guard
plugins.description: Redacts secrets from your prompts and tool output, warns when you paste one, and asks before a secret is written or run; optional local Presidio for PII.

plugins.name: context-bar
plugins.description: Context fill and the live plan, task list or current step in one line above the prompt; /progress opens a Progress pane.
